integrity: A conditional-probability proof establishes the claimed matrix for all integers n>=2. A standard-library verifier passed exact comparisons against complete permutation enumeration for n=2..8 and finite algebraic checks for n=2..99; finite computations alone are not the general proof.
scientific_limitations: Finite-dimensional uniform permutations only; full record/fixed-point joint law and distributional independence are not asserted. Relevant inaccessible historical full text leaves residual priority uncertainty.
title: Triangular record–fixed-point dependence in a uniform permutation
